newsitem.title: INDIA: India Hind Lever Chem up 10 pct on BSE.
newsitem.headline: India Hind Lever Chem up 10 pct on BSE.

text.p: Shares of fertiliser and bulk chemicals firm Hindustan Lever Chemicals rose 47 rupees, or 9.9 percent, to 519.25 on the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE) on Wednesday, traders said.
They said there were some buyers in the stock after it announced improved results for calendar 1996 last week.
Hindustan Lever Chemicals -- a unit of leading soaps and detergents producer Hindustan Lever -- said last week its profit after tax climbed to 174 million rupees in 1996.
The previous year's figures are not comparable as the firm hived off its detergents business to Hindustan Lever.
The firm's shares jumped 42.75 rupees to 472.25 on Tuesday on the BSE.
